deployments_detail.use: "LoccazIA" — AI virtual avatar/assistant for used-car sales via Autocaz (Auto Hall subsidiary)

LoccazIA, an AI-powered virtual avatar / intelligent assistant for Autocaz (Auto Hall Occasion subsidiary), designed to guide customers through buying, selling, trade-in and administrative steps for used vehicles. Built in partnership with Moroccan AI agency IAgency. [IAgency (IAGENCY)]
LoccazIA deployed as an intelligent assistant available 24/7 on WhatsApp to answer customer questions and handle auto-related queries and procedures for Autocaz. [IAgency (IAGENCY)]

Planned integration of LoccazIA into the Autocaz.ma website as an interactive AI assistant answering customer questions in real time (announced second phase, not yet launched at time of reporting). [IAgency (IAGENCY)]
LoccazIA used as an AI-generated animated avatar that replaces human presenters as the official digital spokesperson in all Autocaz marketing/communication videos. [IAgency (IAGENCY)]

LoccazIA promoted alongside Autocaz's new 'Abonnement Flexible' subscription offer as the AI assistant supporting the digitalized customer experience for flexible used-car subscriptions. [IAgency (IAGENCY)]
